checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: enforce claim status/verdict consistency and verdict text validation

impact_assessment.why: Claims could load with a status contradicting their verdict history, and verdict evidence/timestamps were unvalidated; a checksum-valid forged snapshot could assert an unsupported status.
impact_assessment.benefits: Status is derived from the last verdict; inconsistent claims, empty verdict evidence/timestamps and forged-checksum store snapshots are rejected while consistent legacy payloads still load.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Claim/Verdict construction now validates, from_dict is stricter; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve proposed-with-no-verdicts and last-verdict status; test construction and load; keep legacy consistent payloads; run 420 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: lock release must not delete a successor lock

impact_assessment.why: All three advisory locks unlinked the lock path unconditionally; a slow writer whose lock was stolen could delete the successor's lock and admit concurrent writers.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each acquisition writes a unique token and release only unlinks a matching lock; normal release is unchanged, stolen-lock successors survive.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: lock file content gains a token, callers unaffected; dependency: os.urandom/time_ns; concurrency: improves mutual exclusion; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Apply the same rule to telemetry, claim and calibration locks; add a normal-release and stolen-successor test for each; run 423 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: validate stored policy/workspace digests and add the workspace pin

impact_assessment.why: The episode verifier accepted any non-empty policy string and ignored the stored workspace digest, so a malformed policy was recomputed and the source-tree evidence was never checked.
impact_assessment.benefits: Stored policy/workspace must be 64-hex; an optional expected workspace pin rejects a wrong or missing tree; claim verification passes both pins through.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: verifier kwargs only, header unchanged; dependency: workspace_digest for callers; concurrency: read-only; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate both expected digests, require verify_episodes for claim pins, keep None as old behavior; test current/wrong/missing/invalid and claims; run 430 tests and AIKit.

[1/4] Plan: optional HMAC-SHA256 for claim-store snapshots

impact_assessment.why: A rewritten claims payload with a recomputed checksum passed; the store boundary was checksum-only.
impact_assessment.benefits: A caller-held key authenticates the snapshot including its checksum; wrong/missing MACs fail while the valid primary is preserved.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: optional store kwargs, schema gains optional mac; dependency: stdlib hmac; concurrency: unchanged lock; state: optional field.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Exclude mac from the checksum, keep unkeyed snapshots byte-compatible, do not quarantine on MAC errors; test keyed/wrong/missing/tampered and rerun 434 tests.
